title: High Seas Surgery Without Anesthesia
hook: The carpenter sawed off your shattered leg in 90 seconds.

scenes.text: In 18th-century sea battles, cannonballs rarely killed men directly—flying jagged oak splinters did.

scenes.text: Because real doctors were rare on pirate ships, the ship's carpenter—trained only in sawing wood planks—performed amputations.
